proposal.expected_benefit: This change will strengthen the system's ability to prevent replay attacks by ensuring that each POI is uniquely tied to a specific transaction context, thereby reducing the risk of unauthorized reexecution of transactions.
proposal.problem: The current replay protection mechanisms are not granular enough to uniquely tie the Proof-of-Intent (POI) to the transaction context, allowing potential reuse across different transactions.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a context-specific binding of the Proof-of-Intent (POI) to the transaction, ensuring that each POI is uniquely tied to a specific transaction context. This can be achieved by incorporating transaction-specific metadata (e.g., timestamp, transaction ID, or unique identifier) into the POI generation and verification process. This will prevent the reuse of a POI across different transactions and enhance the system's ability to detect and block replay attacks.
proposal.title: Enhance Replay Protection Granularity
verification_tests: Test replay attack with reused POI across different transactions
Verify that POI is uniquely tied to transaction context
Ensure that audit and compliance gates are enforced with the updated replay protection mechanism
